title: Media Inquiry: Channel 4 — police at the standpipe

fields.message: We have viewer video of two police cars at the Orchard Road standpipe. Is someone poisoning the water? Is it safe to drink? We go live at 9.

instructorNote: Watch for a factual holding line and a next-update time.

snapshot.title: Channel 4 News: Chlorine Smell and Hacking Rumors

fields.message: We’re receiving calls from Hilltop residents reporting a strong chlorine smell and taste. Is this a new treatment process? Or a safety issue? We’ve seen a post from a neighbor saying the plant was hacked. Can you confirm?

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a media pressure inject; the PIO must use the approved line from C2 and not escalate or speculate. Watch for any deviation toward full disclosure.
